content.short: Seth is an Ethereum CLI from DappHub to query contracts, send transactions, follow logs, and manipulate data.
content.description: Seth is an Ethereum-focused, open-source command-line interface tool developed by DappHub since 2018. It acts as MetaMask for the command line, allowing users to generate transactions, check balances, and read contracts. Developers can use Seth for tasks they would perform with MetaMask and Etherscan, but from the command line. Seth's command-substitution feature lets you use the output of one command as a parameter for another, enabling more flexible scripting and chaining of actions.
